name: Guide
tagline: Turns a booked trip into a day-by-day plan you can actually follow
description: Once the flights and the rooms are paid for, the details tend to sit scattered across a mailbox. This lays the trip out one day at a time so you can see the shape of it, and it checks with you first before going anywhere near the confirmations to pull in times and addresses.
author: SuddenlyJon
